name: template-event
title: Event page
description: A starter site for a one-day event in Panjim: a header with a language switcher, a hero scene behind its poster, the agenda that knows what is on stage now, the speakers, the venue and a footer, in English and in Konkani in both scripts. Static files with no build step; `susegad create` writes it and copies the pieces it uses.

budget.reason: Mostly words, not code: strings.js holds the whole page in three languages (about 12 KB in English alone, and Devanagari takes three bytes a letter), plus the optional page writer (pages.mjs). The code is the page script (about 1.6 KB), the look reader and the writer, a few KB between them.

motif.gloss: A Goan desk at dawn behind a civic event; the picture is the pahat scene, which draws no deity or ritual.
